retrain_discriminator: python scripts/stages/prepare_discriminator_pairs.py --ordinary-pairs "{pairs}" --explicit-copy-controls "$COEVO_EXPLICIT_COPY_CONTROLS" --useless-controls "$COEVO_USELESS_CONTROLS" --natural-copy-pairs "$COEVO_NATURAL_COPY_PAIRS" --output "{round_dir}/all_discriminator_pairs.jsonl" --seed {round} && python scripts/train_behavior_discriminator.py --student-checkpoint "{current_student}" --pairs "{round_dir}/all_discriminator_pairs.jsonl" --output-dir "{round_dir}/discriminator" --seed {round} && python scripts/stages/discriminator_result.py --report "{round_dir}/discriminator/discriminator_report.json" --checkpoint "{round_dir}/discriminator" --ordinary-pairs "{pairs}" --round-index {round} --output "{output}" && bash scripts/stop_role.sh behavior_discriminator && bash scripts/start_role.sh behavior_discriminator "{round_dir}/discriminator"
rollback_student: bash scripts/stop_role.sh policy && bash scripts/start_role.sh policy "{previous}"
rollback_hinter: bash scripts/stop_role.sh hinter && bash scripts/start_role.sh hinter "{previous}"
